# Welcome to Jannis & Felix

::: {.post-meta}
Oct 28, 2025
:::

`r img_html("news_welcome", alt = "Welcome", class = "post-image", style = "width: 50%; display: block; margin: 0 auto 20px;")`


We are happy to welcome two new members who join the lab on November 1st.

**Dr. Johannes (Jannis) Tossounidis** is a clinician-scientist and recipient of the Alfred Gasche Fellowship. He will spend a one-year research rotation in the lab.

**Felix Theiss** joins us as a PhD student, coming from the University of Bochum.

Welcome to the team – we are looking forward to working with you both!
:::
